description: Turns the app's published web into an Android app. store "google": "set" the Play credentials (entered by the developer; the app must already exist in Play Console), "build" uploads a bundle to the track, "remove" forgets the credentials. store "apk": "build" a signed .apk, whose download link (7 days, anyone with it can install) the status gives when ready; "link" makes a new link, "revoke" stops every link, "export" gives the signing key, once. set and build: owner only. "apple" is not available yet. Builds run in the background (status: neblla_publish_store_read). More: neblla_get_llms tools/publish_store

action.description: What to do. By action: set {packageName, serviceAccountJson, track?, certs?}; link {revokeOld?}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

certs.description: set (google): SHA-256 fingerprints of the app signing certificate; the app then opens full screen.

packageName.description: set: e.g. com.studio.game; fixed once published.

revokeOld.description: apk link: stop the older links first.

serviceAccountJson.description: set (google): the Play service account key, as the JSON text Google gives.

name: neblla_publish_store
title: Build for Android stores
